An unidentified [[Gorax/Legends|Gorax]] on the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]] kidnapped the humans [[Jeremitt Towani|Jeremitt]] and [[Catarine Towani]] and kept them in a cage in its [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|fortress lair]], before the children of the two humans and a band of Ewoks traveled to the beast's lair to free them. A battle ensued between the rescue party and the Gorax, which ended with the beast falling down a massive chasm to its death.

==Biography==
When the [[Towani family star cruiser]] carrying the [[Towani family|Towani]] family crash landed on the [[Endor|Forest Moon of Endor]], the two adult humans known as [[Jeremitt Towani|Jeremitt]] and [[Catarine Towani]] were kidnapped by the Gorax, who took them to its [[Forbidden Fortress of the Gorax|fortress lair]] and kept them in a cage as pets. The Gorax also kept a boar-wolf as a pet.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>

The Towani's children, [[Cindel Towani|Cindel]] and [[Mace Towani]], and a band of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] traveled to the Fortress to free their parents. They climbed the steps to the top, where they found the Gorax's lair. Mace heard the Gorax, and told the others to run and hide with him. However, [[Weechee Warrick|Weechee]] did not make it out in time, and had to hide behind the Gorax's giant ax as the Gorax sat down at his table, eating off of a bone. It got up to look at its next meal: Jeremitt and Catarine, who were hanging in a cage from the ceiling.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

[[Weechee]] accidentally knocked the ax over, which garnered the Gorax's attention, and it came after him. He ran to the rest of the group, who again ran and hid. Mace wonderrf how they will reach their parents, and [[Chukha-Trok/Legends|Chukha-Trok]] suggested they use the Gorax's ax as a lever. Mace stood on one end, at which point Jeremitt and Catarine noticed him. Chukha-Trok and Deej jumped off a ledge onto the other end of the lever, which sent Mace flying up into the air, where he grabbed hold of the cage containing his parents. Mace threw down a rope, and introduced Chukha-Trok as "a friend" as he climbed up.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

Mace climbed down first, but as soon as he reached the bottom, the Gorax noticed their activity. Weechee distracted it by hiding under a basket and moving across the floor. The Gorax smashed the basket, but found nothing underneath. Weechee ran out from behind a corner, enraging the Gorax. Meanwhile, everyone continued climbing down from the cage, which was beginning to break. Weechee ran back to warn them, with the Gorax on his trail. The cage broke, and Chukha-Trok fell into the hands of Jeremitt. They ran out of the Gorax's lair, but Chukha-Trok stayed behind and repeatedly attacked the Gorax's foot with his ax.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

As Mace yelled for him to come on, Izrina lit up in his pocket. Mace unleashed Izrina on the Gorax, which disoriented it, while Chukha-Trok continued his attacks. In a rage, the Gorax striked the walls of his fortress, which caused rocks to crumble and fall on Chukha-Trok. Mace ran to him, but realizes that Chukha-Trok is dying. Before he died, Chukha-Trok gives Mace his ax.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

The Gorax chased the survivors down the giant steps, but they used a pulled-tight rope to trip him. Kaink then used her magic wand to cause a stalactite to fall on his head. Catarine then used Mace's [[Towani family's blaster|blaster]] to shoot the Gorax in the chest, which caused him to fall off the ledge into the pit. Mace shows Deej Chukha-Trok's ax, and explained his sacrifice to them.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

Cindel, Wicket and Widdle appeared on the other side of the chasm. But at that moment, the Gorax emerged from the pit and moved toward them. Mace threw Chukha-Trok's ax into the Gorax's back, which caused it to fall back into the pit, to its death.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

==Personality and traits==
The Gorax proved to be a somewhat curious and inquisitive creature, as it kept the Towanis as pets rather than killing them. It was also intelligent enough to use simple tools and weapons. It was also highly aggressive towards intruders in its home, as it attempted to kill the Towani children and Ewoks who entered its lair.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MCQ-gorax.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gorax concept art by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]]]
The Gorax species made its first appearance in the [[1984]] TV movie ''[[Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure]]''.<ref name="Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure" /> It was played by [[Jon Berg]],<ref name="Industrial Light & Magic: The Art of Special Effects">''[[Industrial Light & Magic: The Art of Special Effects]]''</ref> who also designed it. He portrayed it with both a stop-motion model as well as himself in costume.<ref name="Smith">{{WebCite|url=https://www.yahoo.com/tv/star-wars-ewoks-caravan-of-courage-the-battle-190346641.html|text='Star Wars': How the Ewoks Came to TV 31 Years Ago|author=Alter, Ethan|date=2015-12-15|work=[[Wikipedia:Yahoo!|Yahoo!]]|archivedate=20200805194445}}</ref>
